# Zhihu

> Zhihu is China's leading Q&A and content platform where users ask questions, share knowledge, and publish articles across diverse topics.

Zhihu operates as a community-driven knowledge platform with integrated content creation tools (Zhihu Column), discovery features, and a comprehensive legal framework protecting user rights and data security. The platform is governed by multiple Chinese data protection and cybersecurity regulations.

## Key Topics

- Zhihu Platform
- Zhihu App
- Zhihu Column
- User Agreement
- Privacy Policy
- Personal Information Protection
- Data Security
- Account Security
- Content Policy
- Platform Conduct Rules
- Legal Compliance
- User Rights
- Data Collection
- Account Registration
- Zhihu Salt Select (Premium)

## Core Platform

- [Zhihu Column](https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com): Zhihu Column platform for content creators to publish articles and express themselves freely
- [Discover](https://www.zhihu.com/explore): Zhihu Discover page featuring trending questions and hot topics across the platform

## Legal & Compliance

- [Terms of Service](https://www.zhihu.com/term/zhihu-terms): Zhihu Terms of Service covering user agreement, platform conduct rules, and usage policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.zhihu.com/term/privacy): Zhihu privacy policy on personal data protection, user rights, and data collection practices

## Investor Relations

- [Investor Relations](https://ir.zhihu.com): Zhihu investor relations with financial reports and stock information for shareholders
